name: MemOS
ontology_notes: Cloud/OSS categories include detail_factual, preference, skill, profile, event, tool_memory (add_message.md custom_extract_prompt). Profile is a templated field tree bound to user_id or agent_id. Dream TargetMemoryType is LongTermMemory, SkillMemory, ProfileMemory, PreferenceMemory, InsightMemory, DreamDiary. There is no first-class character autobiography or relationship-state type. A Profile template can include a relationship field as an ordinary attribute.

ontology.evidence: memos-docs.openmem.net/memos_cloud/features/profile.md: Profile template plus instance on user_id or agent_id. add_message.md extracts facts, preferences, Profile, Event Memory, tool memories. src/memos/dream/types.py TargetMemoryType lists LongTerm, Skill, Profile, Preference, Insight, DreamDiary. Companion roles are not types.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: add_message.md: the app posts messages with user_id (required), optional agent_id, conversation_id. MemOS LLM-extracts categories. custom_extract_prompt can restrict a stage for one request. Profile algorithm_updatable can lock fields. Group chat uses role_id/role_name. No documented refusal of intimate text.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: profile.md sequence: searchMemory returns Profile plus other memories; the product puts them in the LLM context. API delete/update exist. Empty search is allowed (the app proceeds without memory). Filters can include agent_id.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: DreamActionType in dream/types.py is create, update, merge, archive. Profile fields overwrite as conversations continue; algorithm_updatable false freezes a field. POST /update/memory edits content/title/status. History of replaced facts is not documented as bi-temporal edges.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: Event Memory is a category. LoCoMo/LongMemEval scores include temporal QA. DreamMemoryLifecycle tracks last_hit_at and decay/archive. There is no documented point-in-time query of fact validity windows.
temporal.label: inferred

identity_split.evidence: add_message.md: user_id is required. agent_id isolates the same user's memories per assistant. Independent Agent memory extracts a separate Agent store and Profile. That is user vs agent, not user vs character vs relationship. Cubes isolate knowledge bases.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: search and Profile recall rank and filter by user/agent/category. No social skip for a relevant memory (trauma, kink, spoilers, jokes).
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Extraction writes model-chosen facts into retrievable memory. README Memory Feedback can correct or replace memories after the fact. No provenance/trust tags or write-time jailbreak filter is documented on the add path.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: POST /delete/memory deletes by memory_ids or clears all memories for user_id or agent_id (api_docs/core/delete_memory.md). Dream archive plus last_hit_at decay. Profile instance delete is separate from fact delete.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: README: add then search. Extraction is async via MemScheduler. Search is hybrid (local plugin FTS5 + vector). Dream is extra LLM. Cloud plugin claims 72% lower token usage vs native OpenClaw. Each chat turn still pays search inject plus later extract.
cost_shape.label: inferred

local.evidence: Apache-2.0. README self-host is docker compose with Neo4j + Qdrant. Local plugin for Hermes/OpenClaw/DeepSeek Harness uses on-device SQLite. Cloud API stores data on MemOS Cloud.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official MemOS MCP Usage Guide at memos-docs.openmem.net/mcp_agent/mcp/guide plus CLI memos-cli. Cloud plugins for OpenClaw/Hermes/DeepSeek Harness are first-party.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: User vs agent Profile and locked fields are the strongest companion-relevant pieces. The store is still extracted facts plus a field tree, retrieved into the chat prompt. No character vs relationship types, no silence, no poisoning filter. Winning LoCoMo/LongMemEval does not score identity drift.

published_eval.name: LoCoMo, LongMemEval, OmniMemEval
published_eval.claimed_score: LoCoMo 88.83; LongMemEval 89.20; PersonaMem v2 40.58; HaluMem 80.91; BEAM-10M 56.75 (README Performance table, OmniMemEval).
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Assistant/user fact QA and agent-task benches. OmniMemEval compares commercial memory products. Not character drift, socially wrong recall, or persona jailbreaks.

open_unknowns: Whether independent Agent memory is on by default in OSS cubes or only Cloud.
Exact extract LLM calls per add_message in current MemOS 2.0.
Whether Event Memory stores validity intervals or only timestamps.
